The '''903 Transport''' or '''Harkners-Balix 903''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ship, similar to the [[Harkners-Balix]] [[917 Transport|917]] and [[922 Transport|922]] models. [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] referred to the ''[[Etherway]]'' as a Harkners-Balix 903 when he met [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] on [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]], as part of an elaborate identification scheme set up by [[Fynn Torve]].
